verdict.rationale: The SDK has a dedicated MCP docs page saying it supports multiple MCP transports so you can reuse existing MCP servers to expose their tools to an agent. The tools docs also list hosted MCP among the OpenAI-managed tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP server integration, documented detail on transport configuration and tool discovery or filtering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: The Agents Python SDK understands multiple MCP transports. This lets you reuse existing MCP servers or build your own to expose filesystem, HTTP, or connector backed tools to an agent.
Use OpenAI-managed tools (web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP, image generation)
